title: AutoOps: Automated Deployment and Canary Testing Operator
tagline: A Kubernetes controller automating canary releases using real-time Prometheus error rates to trigger rolling updates or rollbacks.

problemStatement.overview: Manual deployments run severe crash risks. AutoOps monitors live telemetry data during release steps, incrementally driving traffic between old and new pod instances and halting progress if exceptions spike.
problemStatement.targetAudience: DevOps Teams, Release Managers, Cloud Architects
userPersonas: Site Reliability Engineer enforcing automated rollover standards.

systemArchitecture.narrative: A custom controller loops in Kubernetes. It manages Canary resource manifests and modifies proxy weights to direct traffic increments.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: New Canary version -> Traffic weighted 10% -> Fetch Prometheus query -> Error rates healthy -> Increase weight -> Complete rollout.

tables.name: deployments
tables.description: Tracks progress of active canary releases.

directoryStructure:
autoops/
├── operator/            # Go/Node operator loop
├── crd/                 # Custom Resource Definitions
└── package.json

roadmap.title: CRD and Controller Setup
tasks: Define custom API specs for Kubernetes custom resources.
Connect controller loops to watch resource changes.

steps: Apply manifests to Kubernetes target using kubectl.

resumeBullets: Engineered a Kubernetes Operator in TypeScript to automate canary rollouts, dropping incident recovery times by 80% through automated rollback logic.

interviewQuestions.question: What metric-evaluation window did you use for canary validations?
interviewQuestions.answerHint: Explain using a sliding-window duration (e.g. 5 minutes) to calculate average error ratios to guard against telemetry noise.

title: BuildGuard: Continuous Integration Security Scanner
tagline: A Docker-based execution pipeline runner statically analyzing project files for exposed API credentials and vulnerability patterns.

problemStatement.overview: Exposing API keys in code commits creates data leaks. BuildGuard intercepts git pushes, runs scans inside ephemeral containers, and reports bugs.
problemStatement.targetAudience: DevOps Engineers, cybersecurity teams, team leads
userPersonas: Security analyst auditing repository branches for leaks

systemArchitecture.narrative: Git hooks trigger scans. Spawn isolated docker runtime container. Compiles output logs and outputs PDF reports.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Commit push event -> Webhook receiver -> Docker container spawn -> Static file analysis -> PDF report compile.

resumeBullets: Developed an automated repository CI security auditor utilizing Go, Docker API, and Postgres.

title: AutoScale: Cloud VM dynamic scaling coordinator
tagline: Polls cloud metrics and schedules nodes scaling operations according to CPU loads trends.

problemStatement.overview: Standard cloud scaling features are slow to respond to traffic spikes. AutoScale tracks trends forecasting load requirements.
problemStatement.targetAudience: SaaS infrastructure engineers, cloud cost optimization leads
userPersonas: SRE seeking to minimize idle EC2 server costs

systemArchitecture.narrative: Fetches Prometheus performance records. Calculates moving average cpu values. Triggers AWS Auto Scaling Groups commands.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Telemetry fetch -> CPU trends analysis -> Scaling decision -> AWS SDK API call -> Server instance spawn.

resumeBullets: Built dynamic scaling coordinator using Python, AWS SDK, and Prometheus metrics forecasts.

title: StatusSage: Real-time Infrastructure status panel page
tagline: Renders modern status pages, checking endpoints health and displaying history incident logs.

problemStatement.overview: Outages occur without immediate customer warning boards. StatusSage regularly tests routes, updating a public status card list.
problemStatement.targetAudience: SaaS operators, IT teams, small companies leads
userPersonas: Customer check support portal during a service outage

systemArchitecture.narrative: A cron job tests http targets. Logs success/fail codes. Sends metrics updates to database. React renders logs timeline.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Cron query health -> API endpoint checks -> DB write logs -> Public React portal load.

resumeBullets: Developed an automated infrastructure health status portal utilizing Node and Supabase Postgres.

title: EnvSync: Secure multi-server environment variables replicator
tagline: Synchronizes .env variables across development clusters, securing variables at rest using AES-256.

problemStatement.overview: Syncing environment variables manually across team development workstations causes security credentials drops.
problemStatement.targetAudience: SDE teams, DevOps leads, security managers
userPersonas: Lead dev updating private database credentials keys

systemArchitecture.narrative: CLI client pushes variables. Server encrypts payloads. Follower nodes pull updates dynamically.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: CLI variable set -> local encryption (AES-256) -> TLS TCP socket send -> Master Server write -> Worker node sync.

resumeBullets: Developed EnvSync variables replicator CLI utilizing Rust, TLS TCP sockets, and AES-256.

title: DeployNode: Static Website deployment coordinator CLI
tagline: Compiles static web files, pushing assets to AWS S3 CDNs in seconds.

problemStatement.overview: Uploading build folders manually using web consoles is tedious. DeployNode compresses builds and pushes updates directly.
problemStatement.targetAudience: Web Developers, designers, static site builders
userPersonas: Designer deploying portfolio static pages updates

systemArchitecture.narrative: A node CLI app. Bundles target folders into zip packages. Utilizes S3 multipart API to upload files.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Terminal build build -> DeployNode run -> ZIP compression -> S3 multipart API upload -> CDN invalidation.

advanced: Dynamic upload progress logs terminal bar

resumeBullets: Created S3 static deployment script deploying assets and invalidating CloudFront caches.

title: KubeMon: Light Kubernetes Pod metrics logger dashboard
tagline: Polls pod health metrics, rendering real-time maps of resource usage in local browsers.

problemStatement.overview: Standard dashboards require heavy cluster installations. KubeMon runs a light process connecting local Kubeconfig files.
problemStatement.targetAudience: DevOps Engineers, Kubernetes SRE leads, application developers
userPersonas: Kubernetes developer debugging OOMKilled pod incidents

systemArchitecture.narrative: Reads local credentials. Connects Go API client. Pipes CPU, Memory metrics to local InfluxDB. React displays metrics maps.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Load Kubeconfig -> Client-Go metrics scrape -> InfluxDB insert -> React dashboard metrics view.

resumeBullets: Engineered KubeMon pod diagnostic tool scraping metrics using Client-Go and InfluxDB.

title: LogSifter: High-frequency logs parser and notifier daemon
tagline: Scans application log files, triggering slack warnings when error counts spike.

problemStatement.overview: Reviewing text logs during outages is slow. LogSifter monitors updates, matching error regex strings dynamically.
problemStatement.targetAudience: Backend developers, system admins, support engineers
userPersonas: Developer verifying payment system stability after deployment

systemArchitecture.narrative: An active system service daemon. Talls active file updates. Compiles metrics logs. Dispatches warnings.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Log file append -> LogSifter regex search -> Database metrics update -> Threshold trigger -> Slack alert message.

resumeBullets: Developed logs audit parser in Go executing regex pattern scans and Slack warning triggers.

title: CloudLock: Cloud resource security compliance audit framework
tagline: Audits AWS resource tags and IAM configurations, triggering alerts for public S3 buckets.

problemStatement.overview: Corporate cloud settings drift over time. CloudLock runs scheduled checks auditing network interfaces security rules.
problemStatement.targetAudience: Information Security Managers, cloud auditors, DevOps leads
userPersonas: Cloud Security Auditor checking IAM policy compliance details

systemArchitecture.narrative: Scheduled loops run checks. Fetches resources maps. Matches tag requirements. Logs drifts details.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Audit trigger -> Boto3 calls -> Scan configs -> Match security schemas rules -> Log drifts reports.

advanced: Public S3 bucket access blocker action

resumeBullets: Architected AWS resource compliance scanner utilizing Python, Boto3 APIs, and AWS Lambda triggers.

title: CertFlow: Automated SSL Cert creator and router helper
tagline: Queries Let's Encrypt APIs, placing SSL cert configurations in Nginx coordinates dynamically.

problemStatement.overview: Manual domain SSL configuration drops services when certificates expire. CertFlow manages domain checks and auto-reloads proxies.
problemStatement.targetAudience: System administrators, hosting providers, backend engineers
userPersonas: IT Admin managing certificate updates for 50+ client domains

systemArchitecture.narrative: A Go service. Performs Let's Encrypt DNS/HTTP challenge checks. Saves certs keys and reloads nginx configs.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Check cert dates -> Trigger ACME challenge -> DNS verification -> Save Cert files -> Reload Nginx config.

advanced: Automatic DNS challenge api driver integration

resumeBullets: Built automated Let's Encrypt ACME certificate router in Go, automating Nginx proxy reloads.
